card.text: Explore Hyperion with Cassini imagery, mapped radial height and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Hyperion is Saturn’s sponge-like, chaotically tumbling moon. Deep craters cover a porous, irregular body whose dark crater floors contrast with brighter icy walls. The displayed orientation and lighting are illustrative; its chaotic tumbling is not simulated.

normal.title: ISS calibrated mosaic
normal.summary: Twelve Cassini frames, including a regional ~100 m/pixel close view. Shape and registration limit detail; shadows and marked gaps remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Cassini-model height relative to a 135 km sphere. Shape errors reach 6 km on the less-observed side.
